correction.claim_text: And in the last three months of 2025, it was down to 1.7 percent.
correction.justification: Justified on the claim text alone, which is the basis the Layer-A classifier is instructed to use: "And in the last three months of 2025, it was down to 1.7 percent" contains no superlative, no causal attribution and no comparison — the three c-eval triggers. All of them belong to the PRECEDING sentence (trump_2026:0030, "my administration has driven core inflation down to the lowest level in more than five years"), which is correctly c-eval and is not changed. What :0031 states is a bare quantity measured against a published data series, which is c-count. The original c-eval was a Layer-A backfill artifact of reading the sentence in its neighbour's context.

moves.how: c-count is a MINISTERIAL shape (verdict.evidential_role.MINISTERIAL_SHAPES), so a SELF source becomes PRIMARY_RECORD and a PARTICIPANT source becomes CORROBORANT. Under c-eval, a SELF source was ATTRIBUTION_ONLY and carried quota weight 0.
c-eval is the one shape in publish.computed_exhibit.INADMISSIBLE_SHAPES, so the ratified exhibit was REFUSED for this claim. c-count is not, so it is now admissible and is attached.

not_changed.why: superlative plus causal attribution — correctly shaped, no exhibit, publishes as already adjudicated

correction.sidecar_untouched: metrics/remediation_v2/shapes_backfill_trump_2026.json still records c-eval. It is the record of what the classifier produced; overwriting it would erase the evidence that a correction happened.

reasoning: The Sep→Dec 2025 three-month annualized core CPI computes to 1.701%, matching the claimed 1.7 percent.

spend_measurement.method: LiteLLM proxy key spend ledger, read before the call and again after it settled: 17.964600 -> 17.968165 = $0.003565, rounded up to $0.0036.
spend_measurement.why_the_in_run_reading_was_wrong: The proxy key's counter is written asynchronously. Read the instant the call returned it still showed the pre-call figure, so the runner reported $0.0000 and the chunk journal banked cost_usd 0.0. The runner now settles before re-reading and keeps the larger of the two figures; the journal's 0.0 for this run is a known under-report, recorded here rather than left to be discovered.
